title: Where is my order?
description: Hi, can you tell me the status of order ORD-45821? I placed it last week and just want to know when it will arrive.

title: Still waiting for an appointment callback
description: I requested a GP appointment three weeks ago and have called the surgery twice with no callback. I need to know when I can be seen. This is frustrating and I feel ignored by the practice.

title: Need to cancel my order
description: Please cancel order ORD-99102. I ordered the wrong item by mistake and it has not shipped yet.

title: Reception staff were wonderful today
description: I came in for a routine check and the reception team were polite, patient, and really helpful getting me checked in. The nurse was kind too. Just wanted to leave positive feedback.

title: Forgot my password
description: I forgot my account password and need help resetting it so I can log in again.

title: Prescription not ready
description: My repeat prescription was supposed to be ready yesterday but the pharmacy says they never received it from the surgery. Can someone chase this please?

title: How do I get a refund?
description: I returned my item last month. How do I request a refund and how long does it usually take?

title: Doctor never explained my test results
description: I had blood tests two weeks ago. Nobody called me with the results and when I asked, the doctor was rushed and did not explain what the numbers meant. I still do not understand if anything is wrong.

title: Cannot reset password and billing renews tomorrow
description: I have tried resetting my password three times using the forgot password link but I never receive the reset email. I checked spam. This is urgent because I cannot access my billing dashboard and my subscription renews tomorrow.

title: Rude receptionist then no appointment
description: I called at 8am and waited 40 minutes. The receptionist was abrupt, told me there were no appointments for two weeks, and hung up before I could explain my symptoms have been getting worse. I need to be seen.

title: Wrong shipping address on order already packed
description: Order ORD-22018 is packed but not shipped. I entered the wrong shipping address. Can you change it to 14 Oak Street before it leaves the warehouse? I also need confirmation by email.

title: Referral letter never sent to hospital
description: My GP said they would send a referral to the hospital three weeks ago. The hospital has no record of it. My symptoms are ongoing and I am stuck waiting. Please check my records and resend the referral.

title: Payment failed but I was charged twice
description: Checkout showed a payment error for order ORD-77401, but my bank shows two charges. I need this investigated and one charge reversed. I still do not know if the order went through.

title: Wrong diagnosis worry after rushed visit
description: I was in and out in under five minutes. The doctor dismissed my chest discomfort as anxiety without examining me properly. I am worried something clinical was missed and I want a second opinion arranged.

title: Want to delete account but keep invoice history
description: I want to permanently delete my account for privacy reasons, but I still need access to past invoices for tax. What is the process and what data is retained?

title: Medication changed without discussion
description: My diabetes insulin was changed on my repeat list without anyone speaking to me. Warfarin also disappeared from my medications list even though I still take it. This feels unsafe. Please review my records.

title: Cancel order, change address, and talk to a human
description: I need to cancel half of order ORD-31055, change the shipping address on the rest, and speak to a human agent today because customer service chat keeps looping. Also confirm refund policy if cancel fails.

title: Cannot get through and dressing is infected
description: After A&E I was told the GP nurse must change my dressing every other day. I have been on hold for ages, told to wait nearly a week, and the wound looks infected. I am vulnerable and high risk. I need urgent clinical help from the practice.

title: Subscription cancelled but still billed and locked out
description: I cancelled my subscription last month, was told confirmation would email, never got it, was charged again today, and now login says account suspended. I need billing fixed, access restored or a full refund, and a written confirmation.

title: Hospital needs results the surgery will not email
description: Urgent care needs test results your surgery organised. I called to get them emailed and staff were reluctant, put me on hold, then said they cannot share without the doctor who is away for a week. The hospital says this is delaying treatment.

title: Obscure API webhook failure in enterprise plan
description: Our enterprise workspace stopped receiving order.updated webhooks after yesterday's dashboard change. HMAC signatures fail validation intermittently. No public docs mention this. We need an engineer, not a FAQ, within 24 hours or our integration stays down.

title: Mixed praise and serious access failure
description: Most of the clinical staff are excellent and I have been with the practice 30 years. But for the last year it has been impossible to get an appointment if you work. Phone queues at 8am fail, the app has no e-consult, and I went without antidepressants for five days. I am leaving a complaint as much as praise.

title: Typo-ridden refund chase with missing order id
description: pls hlp i sent bak the tiem weeks ago stil no mony. bank shows pending then gone. dont have order numer handy maybe it was last month blue widget. need reimburse NOW or il dispute card.

title: Child ear infection results delayed two weeks
description: My 6 year old has severe ear infection with discharge. You took swabs and it has been two weeks with no results and no antibiotics. Reception keeps saying wait. This is not acceptable for a child in pain. I want clinical follow-up today and an explanation of the delay.
